# Assets · Imagery

4 files under `assets/Imagery/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

## Usage notes

Brand applications from the 2026 guidelines, for reference: building signage, business cards, the "Consulting Cohort 101" brochure and letterhead. Moody, directional light; the wordmark is always the hero.
